title: Bound the Retry Budget
concept: Retry transient failures within attempt and time limits

writing.summary: Retry transient failures within attempt and time limits.
writing.rule: A retry needs a transient failure, remaining attempts and a deadline budget.
writing.explanation:
Retries amplify load when a dependency is already failing. Decide whether an error is transient, cap total attempts, and stop when the proposed delay plus one minimum operation budget no longer fits the deadline. Retrying authentication failures or malformed input does not repair them.

Here failed_attempts counts attempts already made, including the one that just failed. Retry only transient failures after at least one attempt, while the count is below the total maximum. Require delay + operation_budget to fit in remaining time, using checked arithmetic so an overflow cannot create a false large budget. Jitter and exponential delay selection are separate policies. Before retrying a write, use the idempotency contract from the HTTP stage; a timing budget does not prevent duplicated effects.

The route project is Task Ledger: first keep a reproducible source history, then expose its data through a CLI and HTTP boundary, persist it in SQL, diagnose failures and prepare a release. This lesson owns one contract in that project. Run the worked example before changing the starter and explain which input makes the tempting shortcut fail.

Terminal practice: Run python3 scripts/retry_probe.py against the desktop readiness endpoint. Stop the service and repeat; inspect the bounded attempt count and request ID. This probe retries an idempotent client GET, rather than automatically retrying service writes.

The compiler lab is independent of the reading question. Edit solution.rs; the app supplies a separate caller with normal, empty and adversarial inputs. A successful unchanged demonstration does not prove your implementation. After the lab, apply the same contract to the route companion project. Its README separates the on-device adapter from the desktop Cargo/TCP profile.
writing.exampleCaption: The worked implementation exercises retry transient failures within attempt and time limits. Its tests demonstrate the stated finite contract.
writing.task: Return true only for a transient failure with 1<=failed_attempts<maximum and checked delay+operation_budget<=remaining. Overflow refuses the retry. Keep the public signature. Open the compiler lab and edit solution.rs; do not edit the private verification caller.
writing.success: The separate caller accepts the changed solution and rejects unchanged TODO, a wrong implementation and a printed success message.
writing.question: What else is needed before retrying a possibly committed write?
writing.feedback: Timeouts and budgets do not prove the previous attempt had no external effect.
